split: Complete official-Train sequences ranked by SHA-256 of delivered pose+confidence fingerprint per behavior. A full sequence is reserved for Train in each target; exact repeated poses stay in one derived role across groups.
validation_limit: Official intromission Train contains one sequence. A disjoint nonempty intromission Train and Valid cannot both be formed. No seven-target Valid aggregate is supported by this split.

official_cross_role_pose_overlap.scope: Source Train in one binary target and source Test in another; official roles preserved. Target-specific Test labels remain owner-only.

privacy: Owner Test labels remain only in owner NPZ. Public delivery contains a public manifest and local-only pointer, with no owner Test arrays or labels.
distribution: Local-only preparation. The CaltechDATA Version 1.0 record displays no license value in its Rights section; no archive or derived NPZ was uploaded.
limits: Pose fingerprints detect exact equality of delivered float32 keypoints and scores, not near duplicates or shared animals.
Prepared source and trusted numeric verification are not reference acceptance or private Test acceptance.
